description: Figure 3.2 is a line plot illustrating ROUGE-1 scores for fine-tuning MBart and T5 models with adapter methods across different values of adapter rank \(r\) on the Gazeta dataset. The x-axis is labeled “\(\log r\)” and appears to use a linear scale with tick labels shown at 0, 2, 4, 6, and 8 (covering approximately 0 to 9). The y-axis is labeled “ROUGE-1,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 up to just under 40 with regularly spaced tick marks every 5 units. Four solid lines with circular markers are shown: a red line labeled “T5 + LoRA,” a purple line labeled “MBart + LoRA,” a green line labeled “T5 + AdaLoRA,” and an orange line labeled “MBart + AdaLoRA.” The red T5+LoRA line starts near 23 at \(\log r=0\), rises to about 28–29 by \(\log r\approx 3\)–4, and then stays roughly flat with a slight decline toward about 27 by \(\log r\approx 9\). The purple MBart+LoRA line starts near 12 at \(\log r=0\), drops to about 5 at \(\log r=1\), then increases sharply to around 20 at \(\log r=2\) and reaches about 27 by \(\log r\approx 4\), remaining near 27 through \(\log r\approx 9\). The green T5+AdaLoRA line begins around 23 at \(\log r=0\), increases steadily to about 30 at \(\log r=2\), reaches roughly 36 by \(\log r=4\), and then stays essentially flat around 36 through the highest \(\log r\) values. The orange MBart+AdaLoRA line starts around 12 at \(\log r=0\), increases to about 21 at \(\log r=2\), rises to roughly 31 at \(\log r=4\), and continues a gradual increase to about 33–34 by \(\log r\approx 9\).
